Print to Clip transfers one sequencer track's current Pattern or Pattern chain to one Live clip. A chain can span eight Patterns, up to 256 steps. A Scene contains assignments across tracks; the guide describes printing each track's Pattern or chain, rather than printing a whole Scene in one operation. See Launchpad/UG/09 Sequencer/11 Print to Clip and Launchpad/UG/09 Sequencer/03 Patterns View/01 Chain.

How do I launch Launchpad sequencer patterns across tracks as a scene?

In Sequencer → Patterns, the 16 pads at the bottom of the grid are sequencer Scenes. Press a Scene to launch its saved Patterns or Pattern chains across the four sequencer tracks. These Scenes control the internal sequencer, while Session View scenes launch Ableton Live clips. See Launchpad/UG/09 Sequencer/04 Scenes.
How do I launch Launchpad sequencer patterns across tracks as a scene?

To assign Patterns, hold a Scene pad and select a Pattern or Pattern chain for each track. Release the Scene pad, then select it to launch the assignments. Editing a Scene does not change playback until the Scene is selected again or its Scene chain cycles back. See Launchpad/UG/09 Sequencer/04 Scenes/01 Assign.
How do I launch Launchpad sequencer patterns across tracks as a scene?

During playback, selecting a Scene queues it until track 1's current Pattern ends. Hold Shift while selecting a Scene to switch immediately. Press two Scene pads together to chain the Scenes between them. See Launchpad/UG/09 Sequencer/04 Scenes/03 Queue and Launchpad/UG/09 Sequencer/04 Scenes/02 Chain.

User guide for the Launchpad, the Novation Launchpad Pro Mk3 grid controller.
Launchpad Pro is a grid controller for producing and performing with Ableton Live or external MIDI hardware.
Its 64 velocity- and pressure-sensitive RGB pads can launch clips, play notes, and sequence steps. The four-track, 32-step sequencer provides probability and mutation controls for evolving patterns.
Eight Custom Modes can send MIDI to software or hardware. The two MIDI output ports extend control to external instruments.
The unit can operate without a computer when powered through its USB-C port by the included wall adapter.
Ableton Live integration: play, record, and produce from the controller.
Pads: 64 RGB pads sense velocity and pressure.
Sequencer: four tracks with 32-step patterns, scenes, probability, and mutation.
Chord Mode: explore, build, save, and play chords from the grid.
Note and Scale Modes: play melodies and chords in key; Drum Mode maps a drum rack to the grid.
MIDI connections: MIDI In, Out 1, and Out 2/Thru connect external equipment.
Custom Modes: eight editable MIDI layouts made with Novation Components.
